Container.Name: kdenlive
Container.Overview: Kdenlive(https://kdenlive.org/) is a powerful free and open source cross-platform video editing program made by the KDE community. Feature rich and production ready.
Container.Requires: This image is unprotected by default __**do not**__ expose it to the internet. Please read https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-kdenlive#security for more information.
Container.Changes:
